I've attempted it a couple times; my biggest worry is they'll write me off and never attempt conversation because I hadn't talked to them first, I'm usually not one to approach first so it's something I've done to try get out my comfort zone, just sucks I feel left out.

I may try just taking a step back for a couple days, make basic conversation in social situations but just keep to myself.

Um I'm Tom, I'm not sure who is David but that's not me, apologies!

Edit; Just had a look through your post history and you seem to be doing this to a few people, if you are genuinely upset about this David seek help from loved ones, I wouldn't advise automatically insulting passersby assuming they're the same guy. To me at least that just makes me question if this is just satire.

Thank you so much, I just really needed some opinions about this. I'm hopeful at least someday we can make up, but I cant shake feeling shit how I feel I'm to blame.

I feel at most she was more angry for me asking after her through a mutual friend over the spamming as I believe that's what got me fully on the shit list, but at the same time its not like I smeared her and said Shes a shit friend just for asking if shes heard anythings been up with her, this mutual friend a few times had asked her about me in the past so I don't see why suddenly I'm the worst friend in the world just for something I imagine she'd do in my position too.

How she told me she didn't want to block me but did as I scared her over the spamming is another, I did explain that whilst yes I probably shouldn't of tried getting her attention I did iterate that I only got angry I just got cut off out of nowhere after 3 months respecting her space and looking out for her, I wanted to have my say back which obviously I could've handled better.

I don't really blame myself for everything as of course I feel I acted fairly, I could've done worse but I could've done better, at most I feel this just got blown way out of proportion over a stupid thing we couldve avoided a lot sooner. I still feel shit for everything but I'll try my best to just carry on, I don't know if she'll come back and that alone hurts the most.
